name: window-kickflip
title: Window Kickflip
description: Make the focused window take flight with a full 2D spin and air thrusters.
author: 0xdhrv

preferences.name: playSound
preferences.title: Sound Effects
preferences.label: Play air thrusters and landing sound
preferences.description: Play quiet sound effects synchronized with the kickflip.

commands.name: window-kickflip
commands.title: Kickflip
commands.description: Launch the focused window into a 360° spin with air thrusters. Requires Screen Recording access.

commands.name: guide
commands.title: Kickflip Guide
commands.description: Learn how Window Kickflip works and launch the animation.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
